Holy Communion hymns in Tonic Solfa

Hymns for the Lord's Supper, also called Holy Communion or the Eucharist, sung before and while the bread and wine are shared. Here are the 5 hymns on NoteFusion, each with the solfa written under the words, staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

  • O Lord, I Am Not Worthy

    O Lord, I am not worthy

    Doh is Bb4/4Tune: NON DIGNUSSolfa PDF

  • Thou, Who at Thy First Eucharist

    Thou, who at Thy first Eucharist didst pray

    Doh is D4/4Tune: UNDE ET MEMORESSolfa PDF

  • To Avert from Men God's Wrath

    To avert from men God's wrath

    Doh is Eb4/4Tune: GETHSEMANESolfa PDF
